label: Gunlance
note: MH3U endgame Gunlance is built around Honed Blade (Sharpness +1 + Attack Up L), Artillery Expert, Guard +1/2, and Razor Sharp or Load Up, with Long/Wide level 4-5 shelling providing fixed damage. 3U caps Artillery at Expert (+15, 20% shell/Wyvern Fire, 90s cooldown); there is no Artillery God. This preset models only Honed Blade's Sharpness +1 and +20 true raw. Artillery Expert, Guard +1/2, Razor Sharp, Load Up, Stamina Recovery Up, shelling type/level, and Wyvern Fire are unmodeled; Honed Blade's Attack Up L still helps the substantial stab damage, but Crit Eye and element are not core GL skills.
